description: Pinned third-party stack for Sovereign Engine. CMake reads method/origin/revision/url/sha256/build_options from this file (cmake/Dependencies.cmake); it is the single source of truth for what is fetched. A lock entry records a selection, not a claim that upstream licenses are interchangeable.
acquisition_method: CMake FetchContent only. Source dependencies: shallow git clone of an upstream tag, then the checked-out commit is verified against 'revision' and configure fails on mismatch. Prebuilt tool packages and release archives: URL download verified with URL_HASH SHA256.

dependencies.name: nlohmann_json
dependencies.purpose: Authoring JSON parse/serialize (scene documents, command batches, journals)
dependencies.redistribution: Header-only; compiled into editor, CLI and runtime. MIT notice must accompany binary distributions.

dependencies.name: EnTT
dependencies.purpose: In-memory ECS component storage behind sov::World (never in persisted or public contracts)
dependencies.redistribution: Header-only code under MIT. Upstream documentation (CC BY 4.0) and logos (CC BY-SA 4.0) are not redistributed.

dependencies.name: SDL3
dependencies.purpose: Window, event collection, input, Vulkan surface creation (SDL renderer and SDL_GPU are disabled)
transitive: Linux build: X11 development headers (libx11-dev, libxext-dev, libxrandr-dev, libxcursor-dev, libxfixes-dev, libxi-dev, libxss-dev, libxtst-dev, libxkbcommon-dev) from the host package manager; libraries are loaded dynamically at runtime
dependencies.redistribution: Statically linked. Zlib license: notice must not be removed from source distributions; binary attribution appreciated, not required.

dependencies.name: Vulkan-Headers
dependencies.purpose: Vulkan API headers (no loader is linked; volk loads the system loader at runtime)
dependencies.redistribution: Headers only; nothing from this package ships in binaries beyond compiled-in constants.

dependencies.name: volk
dependencies.redistribution: Compiled into the Vulkan backend; MIT notice required.

dependencies.name: VulkanMemoryAllocator
dependencies.redistribution: Header-only implementation compiled into the Vulkan backend; MIT notice required.

dependencies.name: imgui
dependencies.purpose: Editor tool UI (docking branch) with SDL3 platform and Vulkan renderer backends
dependencies.redistribution: Editor only; not linked into sovereign-runtime or sovereign-cli. MIT notice required.

dependencies.name: dxc
dependencies.purpose: Offline HLSL -> SPIR-V shader compiler (build tool, never shipped)
dependencies.reported_version: libdxcompiler.so: 1.9(dev;4950-b106a961); libdxil.so: 1.9 (as printed by 'dxc --version' from the Linux package)

windows-x64.note: Checksum recorded from the downloaded archive; this package has not been executed on Windows.

dependencies.redistribution: Build tool only. Compiled SPIR-V output is engine-owned; the compiler binaries are not redistributed.

source_build.note: Default on non-Windows hosts (ADR-015). The prebuilt Linux package bundles LICENSE-MS.txt whose terms say 'solely for use on Windows' while its own ReleaseNotes say LICENSE-LLVM.txt applies to all files; that contradiction is unresolved, so the prebuilt Linux package is only used when SOV_DXC_ALLOW_PREBUILT=ON is set explicitly.
